objective.rationale: The catalogue objectives audit's WO-B row, tracing the objective to the piece's own prose: the script doc's framing beat — 'A NEW CAPACITY … a civilization-level capability, not a product feature' — on B's globe plate, and the origin beat (the 2017 'Attention Is All You Need' paper card). objective.record: Migration decision, 2026-10-26 (JOB MIGRATION-16), taken on the objectives audit's evidence per the all-31 order law — the objective is decided FIRST, from the piece's own records, not backfilled as history. One caveat carried openly: the audit's tracing evidence is the TOKENS iteration's prose (the audit predates the package reconciliation); the delivered build — the 'What Kind of AGI?' video this package assembles — serves the same objective through its own closing movement (L14 'Same six parts.'; L15 'One difference: who owns the layer.'; L16 'So the question was never only when AGI arrives.'): the capacity the tokens text names is what makes the delivered text's ownership question a civilisational one rather than a product choice. message.value: AGI comes in two kinds — artificial and augmented — built from the same parts; which kind gets built is a choice, and the viewer is asked to make it.
message.rationale: The delivered build's own script doc states the teaching: its Decision block rules the contested word ('ARTIFICIAL (their word) vs AUGMENTED (his word) — the one word the whole short turns on'), and the scene's in-scene record DR-SCRIPT states the message in one line: 'the same two-futures teaching opened as a question — what kind of AGI?'. The delivered text performs it: the six parts named (L4–L11), then the split (L12 'Stand them apart from you, owned by someone else: ARTIFICIAL.'; L13 'Wear the same parts as your digital CORTEX: AUGMENTED.'; L14 'Same six parts.'; L15 'One difference: who owns the layer.'), then the question re-posed as a choice the viewer now holds (L16–L17).
message.source: delivered build's script doc (files/short-02b-what-kind-script.md — Decision block + Architecture); scene in-scene record DR-SCRIPT (scene/index.html); delivered transcript (transcript/transcript.md)
message.record: Migration decision, 2026-10-26 (JOB MIGRATION-16): the DELIVERED build's message governs this field, because the delivered build is the piece (package reconciliation, hidden_files/jobs/2026-10-26-package-reconciliation.md). story_structure.value: Question-led bookend: the hook question ('What kind of AGI do we want to build?') → the fork (the popular image of AGI — 'a mind of its own, arriving one day, standing apart from us' — against what AGI is actually made of) → the six parts named one by one (LLM, harness, instructions, hooks, files, tools) → the split named (stand them apart, owned by someone else: ARTIFICIAL — wear the same parts as your digital cortex: AUGMENTED; same six parts; one difference: who owns the layer) → the question re-posed ('So the question was never only when AGI arrives') → the bookend returns, now answerable ('It's where we started: what kind of AGI do we want to build?') → the spoken invitation ('Tell me yours, below.').
story_structure.rationale: The delivered build's script doc declares this architecture in its own Architecture section — bookend first ('The bookend: it returns — So tell me… — now answerable, because the viewer now holds the artificial/augmented distinction'), the split, the six parts 'one by one, as each panel segment lights', and the close chosen deliberately. The delivered text follows the same shape line by line (transcript/transcript.md, L1–L18). STRUCT-2's verdict on the pair's text is SOUND (H-S1 = D, H-S2 = D, H-S8 = D, H-S9 = D).
